integrity: Original cyclic-walk proof and standalone finite cross-check are included; exact publication priority and external independent validation are not established.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary Boolean one-letter boxes on finite loopless symmetric cycles with a fixed root and signed depths 1 through n-1; no claim about arbitrary modal formulas, reflexive frames, aggregation impossibility or historical uniqueness. Numerical checks are finite and distinct from the general proof.
title: Minimal inconsistent modal-depth agendas on undirected cycles
